messages:
support_jess: heads up — customer ACME (acct-acme-42) opened a Sev2 about p99 jumps after the 02:10 deploy. seeing sustained p99 ~3.2s from ~700ms baseline. ticket 8921. :rotating_light:
sre_oncall_sarah: :eyes: link /s/8921 logs? any correlated errors or 5xx?
support_jess: no 5xx, traces show requests queued inside the continuous batcher. spans show time in `batcher.wait_for_batch` is the bulk of the tail. attached a flame snippet.

alex: rolling deploy message? deploy-bot: deploy-production v2026.04.12-02:10 by ryan — batcher-config changes: hold_window reduced 30ms->10ms, min_batch_size bumped 4->8, grace_window disabled.

ryan: I flipped those to reduce cost for small prompts — likely candidate.

maria: small prompts + higher min_batch_size can cause partial fill starvation — if arrivals are spiky, some requests wait for others and linger. disabling grace hurts prefix cache reuse too.

sre_oncall_sarah: can we reproduce in canary? what's the repro steps from support?
support_jess: customer sample: many concurrent tiny prompts (avg tokens 6). I pulled a 60s window trace: inter-arrival pattern is bursty with mean inter-arrival 12ms but long gaps ~120ms. p95 fine, p99 bad.

alex: reproduce locally: run loadgen with poisson bursts and those params. quick script borrowed from load-tool:```bash
loadgen --qps 500 --burst-size 40 --burst-interval 0.2 --prompt-size 6 --duration 60 > traces.json
```

maria: also check KV cache eviction/priming — small prompts often benefit from prefix caching. disabling grace window might cause re-request fetches and cause queuing at the batcher layer.

ryan: live quick mitigation: revert min_batch_size 8->4 and re-enable grace_window=20ms. will that be low risk?

sre_oncall_sarah: approved. do it as a config-only rollout via runtime flag on the cluster. set a 5m canary for 10% traffic then promote.

deploy-bot: starting config rollout: batcher.min_batch_size=4, batcher.grace_window_ms=20 — canary 10%

support_jess: customer saw immediate improvement in canary traces — p99 down to ~850ms on canary.

alex: that's promising. we should also add a short-term guard: adaptive_fallback=true for batcher so when wait time > 150ms we bypass batching and send single requests to fast path. code change?

ryan: runtime toggle exists: batcher.adaptive_bypass_threshold_ms. let's set it to 150ms for prod temporarily.

maria: add metric alarms: if batcher.wait_time_99 > 200ms and p99 > 1s for 2m, auto-rollback batcher config to previous values.

sre_oncall_sarah: created alert rule ABORT_BATCHER_TUNING-#8921 and set to page on policy match.

alex: notes for postmortem: root cause = param combo (min_batch_size increase + removing grace window) + workload pattern (bursty tiny prompts with intermittent gaps) -> amplification of tail due to waiting for batch fill and lack of prefix reuse. Also possible priority inversion in our coalescer when larger batches block small low-latency paths.

maria: recommended longer-term fixes: 1) make grace_window adaptive based on short-term arrival variance, 2) make min_batch_size target throughput-based instead of fixed, 3) fast-path bypass when individual wait exceeds threshold (as we toggled), 4) improve observability: per-batch size distribution and wait_time heatmap.

ryan: I'll open a runtime-ops PR to add `adaptive_grace_window` + `bypass_on_wait_ms`. assign to eng-runtime.

alex: also capture reproducer in regression-tests: add small-prompt burst pattern to our CI load tests and run with both old/new configs.

sre_oncall_sarah: outcome: rolled config change to prod (rollback of the 02:10 change) + set adaptive_bypass 150ms. monitoring for 30m. customer ACME confirms latency drop. marking Sev2 -> monitoring.

support_jess: customer confirmed resolution in ticket 8921, thanks team. :white_check_mark:

maria: follow-up: I'll draft a short doc for SRE runbook for batcher tuning and include safe ranges for min_batch_size/grace_window for tiny-prompt workloads.

alex: assign follow-up action items: RUNTIME-432 add adaptive grace, RUNTIME-433 bypass toggle + alert, SRE-221 add synthetic test, DOCS-88 runbook.

sre_oncall_sarah: thanks all. please paste any additional traces into ticket 8921 for the postmortem.

support_jess: adding final logs and link to canary traces. closing thread.
